RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 35

An all-male panel is weak evidence by itself — it reflects the demographics of senior engineering more than intent, and many such panels pick women. Treat it as context, not your argument.

Your stronger points are substantive: a seven-year experience gap and three major projects led, against a vague, highly subjective criterion ("excellent client relationships") of the kind that tends to absorb unexamined bias. And the unanswered two-week-old request is the clearest problem — silence is bad practice and looks poor later.

So: chase the written explanation first, in writing, with a deadline. Ask what the assessment criteria and weightings were. Mention panel composition only if the reasons come back thin or shifting.
